title: Do-It-Yourself Salmon Poke Bowls
description: Do-it-yourself salmon poke bowls are easy with this flexible recipe any time you want a custom salmon poke bowl at home. The topping options are endless.
ingredients: 0.75 pound sashimi-grade salmon, cut into small cubes
1 red bell pepper, sliced, or more to taste
0.25 cup shelled edamame, or more to taste
4 sheets dried seaweed, cut into strips, or to taste
1 tablespoon pickled ginger, or to taste
1 tablespoon furikake (Japanese nori seasoning), or to taste
2 tablespoons chopped green onion, or to taste
1 tablespoon sesame seeds, or to taste

steps.text: Combine soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, sesame oil, and chile oil in a bowl; add salmon and toss to coat. Divide among the four bowls.
Top bowls with avocado, bell pepper, edamame, seaweed, pickled ginger, and furikake seasoning. Garnish with chopped green onion; sprinkle with sesame seeds.
